Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal (training) › Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal › Fitting PN-4471-C
## Fitting PN-4471-C
- Fit the cartridge without tilting it
- Don't mix PN-4471-B and PN-4471-C parts
The old torque of 22 N·m applied to PN-4471-B.
Fabrikam Seals confirmed 25 N·m for PN-4471-C.

SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
# SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
This revision replaces PN-4471-B with PN-4471-C, following ECN-2291.
1. Apply lockout/tagout to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines, as safety bulletin SB-0932 requires.
2. Drain the casing and remove the coupling guard.
3. Remove the seal housing and the old seal.
4. Fit mechanical seal PN-4471-C.
Don't mix PN-4471-B and PN-4471-C parts.
5. Tighten the seal gland nuts evenly to 25 N·m.
7. Record the seal's part number and the operating hours in the work order.

Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal (training) › Replacing the CP-200 mechanical seal › Parts and tools
## Parts and tools
- Seal cartridge PN-4471-C
- New casing gaskets PN-2205-C
- Torque wrench, 5 to 60 N·m
Check the part number on the box.
Remaining PN-4471-B stock is quarantined; never fit it.
